notes.title: Rainbow Update - Achievements, clothes and rainbows
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33858883/4d5e8bf71f2dea64707c570f667a734ca8628494.jpg[/img]
We did a ton of bug fixing and added some new components. We hope you will like it.

The score system have been reworked, which means it might show gold medals, but in order to get the new achievements, you need to redo the levels and get a new medal. [b]Yes that’s right we added steam achievements as well.[/b]

We added a new version of Adam, he can now wear a suit and shot rainbows instead of poop. We also added animations to the poop-o-meter. When you complete the game you will get a gold suit, including gold cape and gold helmet.

Some of the achievements are really hard to get, maybe impossible. We would like to challenge you to get them all, the first person who gets all achievements and provides proof will get the chance to get his or her picture framed in our office on the wall of fame. Will it be you?

If you encounter any bugs let us know.

notes.title: Post launch update
notes.content:
Thank you so much for playing our game. We are really happy with the reception.

Bug fixes:
- Performance enhanced after several deaths.
- GUI is now fixed for small resolutions.
- Both CTRL buttons are now useable and mapped.
- Hide cursor in-game if not used.
- Time score is now adjusted to fit better.
- Fixed bug where a level 15 would show.

Adds:
- We added localization for Danish and German.
- A restart button. "Y" on X-Box controllers and "R" on the keyboard.

If you encounter any bugs let us know.
